summary: 산지 숲에 사는 여름새로, 온대와 열대 지방에서 번식한다. 습성이 뻐꾸기와 비슷해 둥지를 짓지 않고 큰유리새 같은 다른 새의 둥지에 알을 낳아 맡긴다. 아시아 동부와 한국(평안북도 용암포)에 분포한다.

art.subject: Northern Hawk-Cuckoo (Hierococcyx hyperythrus), adult as seen in Korean mountain forests from May to August: head, chin and neck sides dark bluish slate-grey, with whitish lores edged slate; upperparts and wings dark slate-grey to grey-brown; lower throat and breast washed rufous-orange, paling to white on the belly; undertail coverts white; tail brownish-grey crossed by three or four narrow black bars, a broad black subterminal band and a reddish-grey tip. Bill dark with a yellowish base; yellow eye-ring; legs yellow.
art.pose: perched on a branch inside the forest, side view
art.scene: Korean mountain forest in summer; no people, buildings or text
views: adult, side view perched: dark bluish slate-grey head, chin and neck sides, whitish lores, slate-grey back, rufous-orange breast fading to a white belly, white undertail coverts, banded brownish-grey tail, yellow eye-ring and legs
adult, tail seen from below: brownish-grey tail with three or four narrow black bars, a broad black subterminal band and a reddish-grey tip, white undertail coverts
art.build: Medium-sized, long-tailed cuckoo, about the size of a Common Cuckoo but stockier and broader-winged, strongly resembling a small accipiter hawk in shape; perches upright to horizontal inside the forest. Bill short and slightly decurved, not hooked like a raptor's. Legs short, yellow, with two toes forward and two back. The long, broad, banded tail extends well beyond the wingtips at rest.
avoid: Do not paint a hooked raptor bill or strong talons; it is a cuckoo with a slender bill and weak zygodactyl feet.
Do not paint the adult's underparts barred black like a Common Cuckoo's; the breast is washed rufous-orange.
Do not paint a plain grey tail; it is boldly banded with a reddish-grey tip.
Do not paint the head brown; it is dark bluish slate-grey.
